appearances.snippet: Fort Huachuca is involved in lawsuits and sworn affidavits regarding 9-11, people who asserted that the prepping for that took place.

verification.notes: The transcript attributes this to unnamed people and unspecified lawsuits or affidavits. Searches of court indexes, government material, and reporting did not identify the asserted filings. The statement has been reframed as an allegation so it does not adopt the underlying September 11 preparation claim as fact.
